verses.en: By the Dawn
And ten nights
And the Even and the Odd
And the night when it departeth

verses.ar: هَلۡ فِي ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمࣱ لِّذِي حِجۡرٍ
verses.en: There surely is an oath for thinking man

verses.ar: أَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
verses.en: Dost thou not consider how thy Lord dealt with (the tribe of) A'ad
With many-columned Iram

verses.ar: ٱلَّتِي لَمۡ يُخۡلَقۡ مِثۡلُهَا فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ
verses.en: The like of which was not created in the lands
And with (the tribe of) Thamud, who clove the rocks in the valley
And with Pharaoh, firm of might
Who (all) were rebellious (to Allah) in these lands
And multiplied iniquity therein
Therefore thy Lord poured on them the disaster of His punishment
Lo! thy Lord is ever watchful

verses.ar: فَأَمَّا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبۡتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكۡرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيٓ أَكۡرَمَنِ
verses.en: As for man, whenever his Lord trieth him by honouring him, and is gracious unto him, he saith: My Lord honoureth me

verses.ar: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبۡتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيۡهِ رِزۡقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيٓ أَهَٰنَنِ
verses.en: But whenever He trieth him by straitening his means of life, he saith: My Lord despiseth me
Nay, but ye (for your part) honour not the orphan
And urge not on the feeding of the poor

verses.ar: وَتَأۡكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكۡلࣰ ا لَّمࣰّ ا
verses.en: And ye devour heritages with devouring greed

verses.ar: وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلۡمَالَ حُبࣰّ ا جَمࣰّ ا
verses.en: And love wealth with abounding love

verses.ar: كَلَّآۖ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ دَكࣰّ ا دَكࣰّ ا
verses.en: Nay, but when the earth is ground to atoms, grinding, grinding

verses.ar: وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلۡمَلَكُ صَفࣰّ ا صَفࣰّ ا
verses.en: And thy Lord shall come with angels, rank on rank

verses.ar: وَجِاْيٓءَ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بِجَهَنَّمَۚ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ
verses.en: And hell is brought near that day; on that day man will remember, but how will the remembrance (then avail him)
He will say: Ah, would that I had sent before me (some provision) for my life
None punisheth as He will punish on that day
None bindeth as He then will bind
But ah! thou soul at peace
Return unto thy Lord, content in His good pleasure
Enter thou among My bondmen
Enter thou My Garden
